description: Free. List the voices the agent can use, by language and country (every destination country, each with a default Fish voice and its sample; Brazil in Brazilian Portuguese), with name, gender and a link to a ~10 s audio sample. Each account picks its voice per country with set_voice (or in its dashboard) and every call uses it; pass a voice id or name as voice in make_call only to change it for one call. Without a chosen voice, the default voice of the destination country is used (Mexico: Emiliano). Signed in, the result also shows your_voices.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the accent, e.g. MX, ES or US

language.description: ISO 639-1 language, e.g. es or en

name: list_voices
title: List voices
